svg.title: DugTrio — Verifiable Sentiment Agent
svg.desc: DugTrio: Telegram agent that scores crypto sentiment from X with RoBERTa and anchors every result on-chain as a verifiable IP asset. $5,000 Solana grant; $450 prize; Top 10 of 232 teams. Recognition: Top 10 / 232 · Superteam. Tech: Python, RoBERTa, FastAPI, Web3.py, Story Protocol.

g.text: Telegram agent that scores crypto sentiment from X with
RoBERTa and anchors every result on-chain as a verifiable IP
